steps: Heat the oil on medium and fry the onion, ginger and garlic for 3 to 4 minutes, until the onion is see-through.
Add the tomato with a splash of water, cover and cook on medium for about 7 minutes, until mushy.
Turn off the heat, let it cool a little, then blend it into a smooth sauce.
Melt the butter in the same pan on low heat and fry the bay leaf and chilli powder for a few seconds.
Pour in the sauce with the salt, sugar and about 50 ml water a person, and bring it to a simmer.
Cook partly covered on medium for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until a little thick but still pourable.
Add the paneer, crushed kasuri methi and garam masala, cover and cook on low for 2 to 3 minutes.
Turn off the heat, stir in the cream, scatter the coriander leaves and serve hot.
note: Two of the three sources cook onion with the tomatoes, so onion is now included; the third uses tomato alone. The single green chilli from one source is left out.
